summary.text: Kacey Carnegie is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 89, which covers parts of the cities of Chesapeake and Suffolk.
Kacey Carnegie has been a member since January 14, 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Kacey Carnegie was born in Portsmouth, Virginia, in 1983.
Kacey Carnegie studied at the University of Richmond (J.D., 2008).
Kacey Carnegie's listed occupation is attorney.
The profile lists Adam Thomas Carnegie as Kacey Carnegie's spouse.
The House profile lists Kacey Carnegie's committee assignments as Privileges and Elections, Courts of Justice, and Public Safety.
